io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.balance

Class AddonBalanceSummary

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.balance.AddonBalanceSummary

  • public final class AddonBalanceSummary
extends java.lang.Object
    Aggregate balance picture of one addon, computed from its scored (non-trivial) items: average power, the single strongest item's score, and how many items are OVERPOWERED (>=70). A sum is deliberately NOT used - it would punish content-rich addons.

      • getVerdict

        @Nonnull
public BalanceVerdict getVerdict()
        The addon's overall verdict, effort-aware. An addon is only BalanceVerdict.OVERPOWERED when it actually contains cheap-yet-strong items (opCount > 0); an addon whose strongest items are all gated behind a heavy grind reads as BalanceVerdict.ENDGAME (earned power, still balanced) even though its peak power is high. This is what keeps a grind-heavy addon from being mislabelled OP.

        Same as of(Collection) but with an externally-computed overpowered count - used when OP is a BalanceVerdict.OVERPOWERED tally (power AND low effort) rather than a raw power threshold.
